target_customer: Enterprise manufacturers in Europe and the US (process, batch and discrete)
problem: When plans change, materials run short or quality issues appear, factory teams coordinate responses by hand across ERP, MES and quality systems.
business_model: Enterprise software: agents deployed per process, expanding over time (pricing not public)

founders.name: Niklas Marxer
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on bringing agentic AI into more than 150 industrial companies.

competitors.name: Plataine
competitors.what: AI agents for manufacturing planning, scheduling and material management

competitors.name: Ameba AI
competitors.what: ERP embedded planning agent adjusting schedules from live signals

competitors.name: Lyzr production planning agents
competitors.what: Agents that pull and push data from SAP, Oracle and MES

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable agent actions inside each plant's ERP, MES and quality systems, with human approval and audit logs, are hard integration problems.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration per plant creates lock in once deployed, but vendors like Plataine and ERP incumbents are moving into agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ERP and MES vendors are adding agents in 2026; no acquisition of Horizontal found.

market_need_then: Manufacturing planning still relies on spreadsheets and manual coordination per industry sources; Horizontal launched 2026-10-21 per Fondo and cites outcomes such as 30 percent less unplanned downtime (company claim, no customers named).

branding.domain_note: Uses horizontal-tech.com, not the plain word domain

identity.voice_and_tone: confident and direct: Your teams should not be the integration layer

brand_strength.rationale: Common word name with a punctuation variant, and brand coverage is limited to a launch article.

outcome_analysis: Horizontal is an active Fall 2026 company that launched publicly on 2026-10-21. The founders combine mechanical engineering with industrial agentic AI deployments. Factory integration is hard and incumbents are adding agents, so pilots turning into paid deployments will decide it. No funding beyond YC and UnternehmerTUM backing is public and no exit exists.
notes: Company site lists backers Y Combinator and UnternehmerTUM Incubator but no amounts, so no rounds recorded. Performance outcomes on the site are company claims. Fondo article says fully autonomous factory is a direction, not demonstrated.
